title: Feature section family (C) + resources (M)
brief: Build the C archetypes on ContentSection with BlockCard/BlockCardSet (§1.4, §3.1, §3.3). BlockCardSet gains lead?: 'auto'|'none' (feature sets pass none; C3 stays the default for the case-study index), size pass-through, and mixed-set handling: a missing image takes a stand-in, or with standIns={false} every card drops its media and the set renders as C-text. BlockCard gains the text-only top hairline (--bcrd-text-rule-*, neutral on every surface, width of the card, 24 to the index or eyebrow) and the at-rest ink arrow glyph after the title's last word on whole-card links (blue on hover is Free). Card images are 16:9 for 3+ and 3:2 for pairs. Sets of 5+ images are composed in the specimen with <Slider perView={3}> around BlockCards; BlockCardSet never imports Slider. Icon cards are ink Solar Bold, h5, body-sm. Per-card CTAs are neutral link-style. C-icon ALWAYS carries a head-track photo aside, and never puts actions in the head track. fold:check is mandatory. Owns BlockCard and BlockCardSet. Show the arrow cue to the owner in the PR (not blocking). Gates: verify, build + aria:check, shots, /audit-component BlockCard. ALSO FIX (BlockCard audit on the branch): give covered linked cards a pressed state distinct from hover (check 9) or argue the exception; fix the stale specificity comment at BlockCard.module.css:31-32; specimen must show horizontal and BlockCardSet cards on every surface and list all six --bcrd colour tokens; bring docs/specs/BlockCard.md fully up to date with Revision 3 (one 3:2 ratio, six colour tokens, border hairline, no title underline, zoom + reduced motion, status merged, appendix re-run); delete --bcrd-radius/--bcrd-shadow absence tokens or argue them; decide peerSize for 6-8 items by track width. ALSO: /case-studies and its specimen go h1 → h3 with no h2 (heading-order); fix via the card band getting an h2 or BlockCard allowing h2 when the set is the page list. CaseStudyIndex passes body={[""]} to PageHero/CtaSection to dodge their types — fix in the tier below (optional body) and render no closing without an action rather than an inline one-off band.

A strip is a Cluster with colGap and rowGap stack. A grid is a Layout with columns {base:2, md:3, lg:5} and colGap/rowGap stack. Rewrite hero titles to ≤ 48 characters and leads to ≤ 26 words, and make all copy meet §1.5. Log every fixture edit in docs/content-changes.md with old and new text. Swap the template-local blocks for kit units: Steps → F, Fit → Contrast, ProofBlock → G-case, Stat → Stat, Thread → Thread, Router → the service list, Cases → M with stand-ins; keep the E diagrams template-local. Assign photos per §5.6; swaps are allowed if the gates pass. Apply the texture signature (§6.4): counterweight on B, horizon above the tint G, closing on L. Add the six routes to fold.config.json. Acceptance per §8.5, including full-page shots at 390 reviewed for cadence and no three same-shape bands, put in front of the owner with the 1470 crops.
